\title{Throughput Analysis of Regional Fulfillment}

\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
We measure fulfillment throughput across three regions and find a
\textbf{4\%} cost increase driven by carrier surcharges.
\end{abstract}

\section{Introduction}
Prior work~\cite{lee2024} modeled throughput as linear. We revisit this
using \dataset{} and show the assumption fails at peak load (see
Section~\ref{sec:results}).

\section{Method}
\label{sec:method}
Throughput $T$ follows
\begin{equation}
T = \frac{U}{\Delta t} \cdot \eta
\end{equation}
where $\eta$ denotes carrier efficiency.

\begin{itemize}
\item Collect unit counts per region
\item Normalize by \textit{delivery window}
\end{itemize}
